column1: # done_enemies (batch 3, _todo rows 201-300) — srcline <TAB> english. Realm badges skipped.

column2: Any way you look at it, it's a rehash of the Diode Bat. Red+green is more vivid than red+blue, huh.
Finally a passable Domain. If your attack only slightly exceeds its defense, you'll take huge reflected damage…
Lanling City, a.k.a. "Blue-Zero City." Since Neko's RPG has no blue key, this stat was changed to fluctuate by VP!
Contrary to popular belief, it has no aura. Surely the Spirit-Vine Furball and Water-Soluble Furball gave the impression that "all blue Furballs are aura Furballs"!
Shenghuang City, a.k.a. "Save-Yellow City." Legend says that there, even a Skyhigh-Tier powerhouse like Haohuang is powerless before enough wealth.
When the D9 spaceship crashed, things from the last epoch came pouring out. Its prime was far beyond this, but now it's nearly out of power… only its defense is still fairly strong.
Seemingly the initial form of the Ruins Light-Chaser. Before learning 【Light-Chase】, it was just an unremarkable Shadow Wildbeast.
Seriously… even birds have learned Hurricane now! You can see the stat-inflation of special attributes at a glance.
It may be unable to damage you due to excess VP, but if you can't hurt it either, this damage reduction ends up rather useless.
A glass-cannon-type Wildbeast. Luckily the blood-gate isn't behind it…
A "balanced"-statted intelligent Wildbeast, a rank-and-filer of the suburban battlefield. (The hidden reading of 属性均衡 is "all stats are trash.")
Seemingly the wraith of a dead 13 Axes member. Peerless has been power-crept out… Hurricane and Light-Chase are the meta now.
Light element is quite scarce on the dark battlefield outside the city. The wind-element insight is a notch less effective, but you make do.
In theory metal with Essence is a whole grade higher… but given iron itself is bottom-tier, Iron Essence won't exceed A9 anyway.
A Gloomy Furball that fought its way out of blood and fire. Strong, but with no staying power.
Gotcha~ it appears at twice the rate of other enemies.
Shenghuang City folk never submit! Unless room and board are covered!
Rather than vicious, it's more that with an absolute-defense tactic, once it grabs treasure it never lets go.
Unlike earlier skeletons, only a skull remains. Though symbiosis with worms restored its mobility, the great aura it leaks drives nearby Wildbeasts into a frenzy.
A Yangang City squad leader. It has no particular weakness, plus a powerful array insight.
A powerful Earth-Tier Peak Wildbeast. Neko, starved for days, finally has something to eat—.
Why do you look so much like the one in 2-1? Are you brothers…? Shieldmen have a lower death rate, so they can accumulate a higher realm.
Flowing-Silver Guard… it's the same kind of existence. Fight to the last moment — then take your own life and ascend!
The name-prefix is "Bloodfall," see. The reason it's not that old is it spent a few centuries traveling through several worlds…
Maybe its realm should be called Planet-Tier Rank 9? Scattered Bloom when not at full health, unbeatable at full health.
A rather annoying Domain. Same stat magnitude as the Ruins Horror; the one good thing is that Hall-of-Fame gems raised the health cap.
At least it lost Scattered Bloom. The realm's low-health harvester is gone for good…
Heavy-Industry series (1/4). Decent output and damage reduction, but limited, fragile health.
Given that attacks in Neko RPG happen line-infantry style… Pincer is utterly useless!
A perfectly ordinary heavy infantry. How did it split off two sets of armor?
Its specialties are Reversal and… Restraint. With defense this low, it's surely a liability…
Huh? Is the one in the Crypt your relative? You look exactly alike.
The mole's here. -20% area aura changed to -10% global aura… area effects are just too hard to pull off, after all (x
Aboard the ship, A9 and B1-tier beings live all jumbled together… oops, wrong film set.
What are "ordinary" and "all-points-into-attack," anyway?
416! 416! 416! I'm a super defense-killer!
No matter how much you hold up a shield, you're not as strong as that Sky-Tier guy. Come to think of it, what's the Crypt Breeder's 600k worth here…
A two-faced mage/bat creature. The bat side seems a bit stronger.
Heavy-Industry series (3/4). The best-coordinated pair of special attributes yet — feels like it can beat even B1-tier beings with ease!
How can a puppet convert damage into life force? Truly an unsolved mystery.
Laser is now an attack effect, not a hit-reaction effect! Whether or not the basic attack lands, the Laser always hits~
Looks like Baifang got two of these nearly-dead guards from who-knows-where. Still, his two are oddly useful — they can do a 6-hit combo.
The pinnacle of the Heavy-Industry series… hah? Time-Seal paired with Shield Drain? Is this a joke? Worse than the Diamond one.
It can summon many Warship Weeders. Though they look a lot like free XP…
Looks like some kind of Aladdin's lamp. But it won't grant your wishes.
As long as you hit it, you won't take the wretched Interception damage. But doesn't "raser" just mean laser…
Actually just a core enemy. The reason the one outside has so many gems… is that it's king of its own hill, desu.
Actually pretty tough, but as long as you have enough wall-breaking pickaxes… I mean Green Knife Coins.
In the end, Light-Chase took MVP. Why keep staring at this damage number? It'll alienate all of Reversal's hard work!
Even a real nuke is nothing more than this. By the way, will the 13 Axes consider recruiting a nuke?
Hah? How much health? Scattered Bloom? You claim you're Sky-Tier Rank 1 and expect anyone to believe it? Quick, go summon the Magic-Attack-Restraint Ancestor!
Still easier than the one below you. So far no toxin can rival the 【Mario Mushroom】…
Precious-metal Furball seems a fine evolution path. Personal opinion, though: the back-to-basics 【Common-Folk Furball】 is the ultimate form.
The Fortify attribute, back after so long(?). Tridents are made for hard rocks like you!
Beware anything to do with 【light】. Sky-Tier Rank 1 has become the same positioning as Arcaea's constant 10.6…
How come it didn't short-circuit the ship's machinery? The insulation work is really well done.
Good heavens—— quark confinement has broken——
It's not stated outright, but the one immune to Greed should be Yangang City's Lord's Manor. Dash has been power-crept out… now even Hurricane is too embarrassed to show its face.
How does the Warhead have a segmented strike like Holy Array?! And way too thick-skinned.
Its base stats are very strong, but thankfully it doesn't have the wondrous insights of those Rank-1 specialized robots.
Wondering why there are so few Sky-Tier Rank 2 enemies? The answer: the alien clans' classification is too strict, so many B2-tier got classified as B1…
Having found a whole swath of his family's soul-lamps snuffed out in the beast-tide, he's furiously preparing to take revenge on the Wildbeasts!
A bat whose bloodline seems quite tough, thick-skinned. But… did something unclean get mixed into your talent?
You're the Yangang Fief's foremost family, so why use poison? *I won't tell you anything!*
A wild "Spirit" carried by fire. Far cooler than a nuke, yet it commands many abilities.
In theory Sky-Tier can already fly. But its combat style and weight mean it won't fly for long.
A puppet imported from Shenghuang City. Being too dumb, it doesn't go starry-eyed at money like other Shenghuang units — at the cost of not telling friend from foe.
A cultivator who joined the extermination operation to counter the beast-tide threat. You ask about the 3-hit combo? Look up at the attack speed (lol
Flower-Spirit Fluid? Feels like a pure pun of an existence.
Does this epoch have some Stone God as its epoch-deity? Everywhere you go there's this gang of Fortified rock monsters. Oh, and many Wildbeasts crashed to death on it, so it's covered in oil…
Sounds like a cat-demon from Area 11. A total no-honor player-ambusher!
The 1-4 Explorer's Wraith also has Otherworld Gate. It seems to be some death-related insight…
When a rat flies into the sky, is it still a rat? Or can it now be classed as a kind of leather-winged bird?
Just picturing a bat swooping down from the sky with a sword in its mouth… really makes me want to laugh, lol
Stare~ (Wakaba Mutsumi reaction image.jpg)
A Sky-Tier knight sounds about as impressive as "aura-into-horse." But it seems "knight" here is just a job title~
What's the difference between a Church and a sect? Anyway, a glass-cannon Church like this doesn't seem long for this world.
Of all martial arts, only speed is unbreakable. That's the creed of these blood-licking mercenaries. Only… they don't seem all that fast.
Balanced stat allocation really is, in a sense, the meta answer. All-defense + Magic Attack has a higher theoretical win rate, but can't adapt to an ever-changing battlefield.
A dragon likewise sped through its growth stage by primal-energy radiation. It seems born knowing how to make one unit of force do the work of two.
An evolved version of a Wildbeast Forest enemy. Do a berserker's art style and insight really match…
Sounds like a XOR Flower. Are there OR Flowers and AND Flowers too?
Too bad there's no Tower-Gate War-Armor B3 here to summon a whole nest at once. Otherwise it'd be a headache too.
Completely different art style from earlier skeletons. 99², 2¹², 7⁴… did it go mad studying math?
Honestly I think the fellow below is better called a "backbone." B4-tier is too low for power, but just right for a monster.
So Furballs can zombify too! I thought they were the type that just melts away on sudden death…
Why is it only humans that can't be made into steak and eaten?
Its clothes are all faded. How many years has it drifted in the Qingye River?
Don't tell me a "Deep Knight" is just one whose clothes are darker. Seems to be a B9-tier 【Blue Gold Essence】 plating… so rich.
